notes.title: Force of Nature Soundtrack is available now!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/868800/Force_of_Nature_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/868800/Force_of_Nature_Soundtrack/[/url]

Quite often I was asked to upload soundtracks for the first part of the Force of Nature. But I was busy developing the second part of the game all the time, so I didn't have enough time and energy to prepare tracks and put them on Steam. However, I finally pulled myself together, allocated a few days for this task and finished it!

All the tracks for the game were created by the Storm Warning! group, which was founded by me and my classmate. These are mostly instrumental parts for songs that we recorded ourselves at home, but there are also a couple of tracks that I created specifically for the game. There are not so many tracks, but a piece of our soul is embedded in each of them. Hope you enjoy them!

notes.title: Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper
notes.content:
Dear friends, I have exciting news to share which I'm sure you will like to hear! For those who have played the Force of Nature game, and for those who have yet to dive into this world: we proudly present you with the sequel called [b]Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper[/b]:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1316230/Force_of_Nature_2_Ghost_Keeper/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1316230/Force_of_Nature_2_Ghost_Keeper/[/url]

It's still, staying true to its core, an RPG adventure where you can build your own base, craft your own weapons and equipment, take care of your homestead, and try to find yourself a way to get back home. You will travel through many unique biomes and locations, fight hundreds of various monsters, defeat bosses, solve puzzles and make new friends along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27148173/e844e7a3374192df534debd138a3b9f5b4874707.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27148173/ea4e66b2c1ba61767018865d2e984350c019fd13.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27148173/c426b4d5cda43bdc3d56655fe533af9fe3f73666.jpg[/img]

In technical terms, the game has taken a huge step forward: modern graphics, high-quality animations and sounds, with more than 30 unique soundtracks exclusively made for the game. I hope that you will appreciate our efforts and enjoy the gameplay.

Invite your friends and join the [b]Discord[/b] channel to discuss the game:

[url=https://discord.gg/QSzdn3Mu2R]https://discord.gg/QSzdn3Mu2R[/url]

notes.title: Force of Nature 2 Development Blog
notes.content:
Hi! I've been developing the second part of the game for quite long time. At this point a lot of work has already been done, so I decided to start a blog in which I'll talk about the progress of work, tell you some details about the game and upload screenshots and videos. I'll try to make a post once in two weeks.
Who interested, please come [url=https://www.fon-game.com/force-of-nature-2/]here[/url]!

Artem

notes.title: Force of Nature: Multiplayer
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27148173/abb4426ef0123df9876edaca78db9e4164f6e7ef.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

Welcome to the biggest update since the game was released! Multiplayer game mode is now available! Currently this mode has the status "Beta", but it is already fully functional.

[b]The main features:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can only play in co-op mode and only with Steam friends
[*]In "General" world maximum 2 players can play simultaneously, in the "Creative" world - 4 players. You cannot play Hardcore world on net
[*]Inventory, equipment and craft progress of guests is saved, so you can leave the game at any time and continue playing later
[*]Only the game host can get new level and pick up important for the progress items (like a gem at the very beginning of the game and the Force of Nature shards). All other features are available to guests
[*]The ability to put a mark on the map is added to coordinate the players. Just open the map and click anywhere - your friends will also see this mark
[/list]

In the near future, I also plan to add player customization.
